verdict.rationale: The docs say a task running on a remote daemon can be controlled from app.humanlayer.com "on a machine or phone" while the agent keeps working on a separate host. Workflows also include review points, and tasks have comment and review surfaces, so a PM can plausibly steer and review agent work from mobile. However, the evidence never explicitly describes approving specific agent decisions or actions from a phone. Missing for 10: documented approval or permission-request flows for key agent decisions, mobile-specific approval UX or push notifications, evidence that agents continue in parallel while awaiting approval, and independent hands-on corroboration.
